title: Crispy British-Style Vegan Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegan stir fry with a crispy British twist, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables (e.g., bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the light British ale and vegan stir-fry sauce to make a marinade.
2. Add the British-style vegan sausages to the marinade and let them sit for at least 30 minutes.
3. Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
4. Add the mixed vegetables to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
5. Add the crispy fried shallots to the skillet and cook for another minute.
6. Remove the sausages from the marinade and add them to the skillet.
7. Cook the sausages for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are browned and cooked through.
8. Serve the sausages and vegetables over rice or noodles.
9. Garnish with additional crispy fried shallots if desired.
